main.description: P16 step 5 of com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.composeCharacterVrm. Runs MediaPipe Face Landmarker (Apache-2.0) on the VKE CPU pool to extract 52 ARKit-compatible blendshape weights + 478 face landmarks from the character reference image. The result is folded into bind_vrm so the VRM has working facial animation out of the gate. Self-hosted on `ghcr.io/etzhayyim/mediapipe-face:1` (no external API). ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_extract_facial_blendshapes.

referenceImageB64.description: Base64-encoded PNG of the character reference.

headLandmark.description: Approx head pose (yaw / pitch / roll degrees + scale) for downstream rig fit.
